column1: # Deployment manifest (SSOT for bin/cli.js and install.sh).
# Columns (tab-separated): scope  target  kind  src  dest  [mode]
#   scope: local (dest relative to project root) | global (dest relative to $HOME)
#          | global-guard (dest relative to $HOME; deployed only with --global --guard)
#          | global-memory (dest relative to $HOME; deployed only with --global --memory-hook)
#   kind:  file (instruction file; a divergent existing dest is saved as .bak) | dir (mirror directory)
#          | settings-hook (merge the hook in src into the Claude Code settings.json at dest)
#          | opencode-permission (merge the permission rules in src into the OpenCode opencode.json at dest)
#   mode:  if-missing (file kind only: never overwrite an existing dest)
#          merge (file kind only: back up a divergent dest and merge its rules into the deployed
#          file as a "Project Rules" section; a dest the harness itself deployed is replaced bare)
# After a dir row is copied, the installers also delete the deployed copy of every path under its src that
# retired.tsv lists (skills and commands removed from the package).
# Target "agents" = the cross-tool Agent Skills location (.agents/skills), read natively by
# Pi, OpenCode, Codex, Copilot and Cursor. Claude Code reads .claude/skills instead.
